title: What a language model is and how it predicts the next token

videos.script: You type a question into a chat window, and an answer appears, one word after another. {{chat}} It looks like somebody thinking. It is something smaller, and more useful to know. {{small}} The model reads the text so far and gives every possible next word a score. One word is picked. It goes on the end of the text, and the model is asked again. {{loop}} That is all generation is. A long answer is that step repeated a few hundred times. {{repeat}} In this lesson you run a model small enough to read. It learnt from seven hundred words about a café. {{toy}} You will watch it score the next word, write a sentence, and get things wrong in the same ways the large ones do. {{wrong}} Everything after this lesson, from tokens to prompts to agents, rests on that one step. {{rest}}
